objective: Gate 7B targeted audit R2: repeat the prior read-only navigation/menu audit with only the failed Sistema_ModulosPermisos query corrected. No INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDL, seed, EXEC or Production.

queries.name: sistema_modulos_columns
queries.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME='Sistema_Modulos' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: sistema_modulos_menus_columns
queries.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME='Sistema_ModulosMenus' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: cava_modules_exact
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM dbo.Sistema_Modulos WHERE LOWER(ISNULL(Codigo,'')) LIKE '%cava%' OR LOWER(ISNULL(Nombre,'')) LIKE '%cava%' ORDER BY ModuloID

queries.name: cava_menu_rows_exact
queries.sql: SELECT mm.* FROM dbo.Sistema_ModulosMenus mm LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_Modulos m ON m.ModuloID=mm.ModuloID WHERE LOWER(ISNULL(mm.Codigo,'')) LIKE '%cava%' OR LOWER(ISNULL(mm.Nombre,'')) LIKE '%cava%' OR LOWER(ISNULL(mm.Ruta,'')) LIKE '%cava%' OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.Codigo,'')) LIKE '%cava%' OR LOWER(ISNULL(m.Nombre,'')) LIKE '%cava%' ORDER BY mm.ModuloID, mm.MenuPadreID, mm.Orden, mm.MenuID

queries.name: sistema_modulos_permissions_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, IS_NULLABLE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME IN ('Sistema_ModulosPermisos','Sistema_ModulosVisibilidad','Usuario_PermisosRolModulo','Sistema_RBAC_Permisos','Sistema_RBAC_RolesPermisos') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: cava_permissions_existing
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 * FROM dbo.Sistema_ModulosPermisos ORDER BY 1
